## Company Overview

LumAIa is an AI-powered platform built by iundf Dewave AG, a Swiss digital and AI transformation agency with 25+ years of experience in marketing, communication, and software development. LumAIa unifies strategy, production, and campaign optimization in one system – not a stack of tools, not a traditional agency, but an infrastructure that translates the expertise of a top agency into software.

**Key Metrics:**
- 90% time saved
- 10x ROI increase
- 70% cost reduction
- 48 hours from briefing to launch

**Contact:**
- Website: https://lumaia.studio
- Email: hello@lumaia.ai

## Platform Architecture

LumAIa covers the entire agency value chain as one continuous system. Each phase hands its result to the next.

### Phase 1: Plan
Strategic thinking at the campaign level: market analysis, personas, media strategy, budget plan. Data-driven and structured – before a single asset is produced.

**Modules:**
- **Briefing Agent** – Entry point of the value chain, validated briefing
- **Market & Audience Intelligence Agent** – Market, competitive, and GEO/SEO analysis
- **Persona Architect** – Data-driven personas
- **Media Strategy Agent** – Channel logic, funnel design
- **Media Planning Agent** – Budgeted media plan
- **Production Planning Agent** – Production brief for the Build phase

### Phase 2: Build
Asset creation in seconds: banners, copy, visuals, landing pages, emails – consistent in your brand voice, for every channel.

**Modules:**
- **Creative Concept & Key Visual Agent** – Core idea + key visuals
- **Media Asset Studio** – Mass production of channel-ready formats
- **Landing Page Agent** – Generate and deploy landing pages
- **Email Agent** – Ready-to-send emails
- **Content & Copy Agent** – Central copy engine, keyword-first
- **Product Asset Studio** (LIVE) – AI-generated product images with Fidelity Scoring and C2PA provenance. Turns a single product image into hero, lifestyle, detail, and micro-rotation assets. EU AI Act compliant.

### Phase 3: Publish
Campaigns go live automatically. Autonomous budget control and real-time optimization run within defined parameters – no manual intervention, around the clock.

**Modules:**
- **Campaign Activation Agent** – Campaign setup and launch across channels
- **Autonomous Optimization Agent** – Variant testing, autonomous budget reallocation
- **Campaign Health Monitor** – Fatigue and anomaly detection

### Phase 4: Report & Learn
Every campaign makes the next one better. Attribution in plain language, management reports, and a learning signal that flows back into strategy and production.

**Modules:**
- **Attribution AI** – Touchpoint attribution
- **Executive Dashboard Agent** – Management summaries
- **Learning Engine** – Flywheel, learning signal back to Plan/Build
- **GEO Visibility & Performance Monitor** – Visibility in answer engines

---

## Trust Architecture

Every campaign and asset runs through the same trust architecture:

1. **Integration Hub** – One data source for the entire marketing chain (PIM/DAM to analytics). No data silos, no manual exports.
2. **Brand and Compliance Guards** – Automatic checks against brand guidelines and legal requirements. Every asset, every time.
3. **Campaign Engineer Gate** – Experienced marketing professionals validate what the system should not decide alone. People stay in control where it matters.

---

## Product Asset Studio (Live Module)

Product Asset Studio turns a single product image into a complete set of:
- **Lifestyle Images** – Product shown in real-use context
- **Hero Shots** – Clean product photos on white background
- **Detailed Close-ups** – Detail shots and quality enhancement up to 4K
- **Micro-Rotation** – Product from multiple angles

**Features:**
- Fidelity Score rating (GREEN/Yellow/RED)
- C2PA provenance record on every image
- EU AI Act compliant
- Campaign Engineer Gate validation
- PIM/DAM/Shop integration via Integration Hub
- Output format: .webp, up to 4K

**Google Standard Compliance:**
Covers Priority 1 of Google's 13 essential attributes for Agentic Inventory Readiness: High Quality images, Lifestyle images, and Additional images.

**Results:**
- 95% time saved vs. traditional photo shoots
- 10x ROI increase through scalable content
- 70% cost reduction per product image set
- 100% brand safety through Campaign Engineer Gate

**Target Audience:** E-commerce and DTC brands with thousands of products needing scalable, compliant image assets.

**Pricing:** From CHF 29/month, no credit card required.

## Agentic Commerce

Agentic Commerce is the act of shopping through autonomous AI agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) without a human guiding every step. The agent searches, compares, and buys on behalf of the consumer.

### Five Key Protocols
1. **ACP** (Agentic Commerce Protocol) – Purchase processes
2. **UCP** (Universal Commerce Protocol) – Structured product data
3. **MCP** (Model Context Protocol) – AI model data access
4. **AP2** (Agent Payments Protocol) – Secure agent payments
5. **A2A** (Agent-to-Agent Protocol) – Agent-to-agent communication

### Three Prerequisites for Agent-Readiness
1. Structured product data (Schema.org, clean attributes)
2. Compliant image assets (C2PA provenance, EU AI Act compliant)
3. Technical accessibility (open interfaces, crawler access)

Product Asset Studio addresses prerequisite #2, delivering compliant, verifiable image assets at scale.

## FAQ

**Is LumAIa a tool or an agency?**
LumAIa is an AI platform that automates the work of an agency – with professionals in the background who review every critical decision.

**How do you ensure brand safety and legal compliance?**
Through the Campaign Engineer Gate: every asset first passes automatic brand and compliance guards. Anything they cannot clearly resolve is reviewed by a person. Nothing is published without review.

**How quickly is LumAIa up and running?**
From brief to first launch typically takes 48 hours. Pilot partners receive onboarding and setup as part of their fixed-price package.

**Which channels are supported?**
Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, TikTok, Display/Programmatic, SEO/AEO, Email/Newsletter, CMS integration.

**What does LumAIa cost?**
Self-serve modules start at CHF 29/month. Pilot partners receive a 12-month fixed price with full module access.

**What does "Pilot Partner" mean?**
A pilot partner secures early, full access to all modules at a guaranteed fixed price and shapes the development of LumAIa directly. Spots are limited.
